messages.text:
YOU AWAKE FROM A
DAZED STUPOR THAT
FEELS LIKE A VERY
BAD HEADACHE AFTERA LONG AND
EXTREMELY UNLUCKY
WEEK SPENT IN
VEGAS.[PAGE]
TAKING INVENTORY
OF YOURSELF, YOU
NOTICE YOUR RIGHT
HAND IS COVERED
WITH BLOOD, THOUGHSTRANGELY, YOU
NEITHER SEE NOR
FEEL ANY WOUNDS.[PAGE]
FEELING A SHARP
PAIN ON YOUR LEFT
FOREARM, YOU ROLL
UP YOUR SLEEVE. A
SMALL PUNCTURE
GIVES YOU PAUSE...[PAGE]
"HAVE I BEEN
GIVEN SOMETHING?"
YOU MUTTER,
HEARING A VOICE
WHICH SOUNDS
STRANGE TO YOUR
EARS.[PAGE]
WITH DAWNING
HORROR, YOU THEN
REALIZE... YOU
DON'T REMEMBER WHOYOU ARE![PAGE]
YOU'VE NO IDEA WHYYOU'RE HERE, OR
EVEN WHERE "HERE"
IS! EVERYTHING'S
A HAZY BLANK![PAGE]
YOU'VE NO MEMORY
WHATSOEVER![END]

IT'S A LIGHT BROWNTRENCH COAT THAT
MATCHES YOUR
TROUSERS.[END]

YOU FEEL SOMETHINGIN THE POCKET OF
THE COAT.[END]

IT LOOKS LIKE
A TYPICAL CEILING
LIGHT.[END]

IT'S A FULL ROLL
OF TOILET PAPER.[PAGE]
IT TENDS TO COME
IN HANDY IN
SURROUNDINGS LIKE
THESE.[END]

THE GLASS IS
EMPTY.[END]

IT'S A GOLD PLATEDLIGHTER. VERY
NICE![PAGE]
YOU NOTICE THE
INITIALS "J.S."
ETCHED ON ITS
SIDE.[END]

THE SHINY GLINT OFA QUARTER CATCHES
THE LIGHT.[END]

THERE'S NOTHING
PARTICULARLY
SPECIAL ABOUT THIS.38 SPECIAL.[END]

IT'S A .38
SPECIAL ROUNDNOSE,LEAD BULLET.[END]

THE CABBY LOOKS
AT YOU AND SAYS,
"SORRY PAL, I
AIN'T GOT ANY
CHANGE![PAGE]
BUT YOU DON'T
HAVE TO PAY
BECAUSE TODAY IS
SPECIAL DAY!"[END]

IT'S A CARD WITH
SEVERAL HOLES
PUNCHED INTO IT.[PAGE]
WRITTEN ACROSS THEBOTTOM ARE THE
WORDS, "PRIVATE
ACCESS, PENTHOUSE
SIEGEL."[END]

YOU ARE UNABLE TO
PUT THEM ON.[PAGE]
THEY'RE TOO BIG.[END]

IT'S A VERY WORN
LEATHER WALLET.[PAGE]
YOU'D HATE TO BE
THE COW THAT IT
CAME FROM![END]

IT'S A PIECE OF
YOUR FAVORITE
CHEWING GUM.[END]

IT'S A USED
HANDKERCHIEF WITH
THE INITIALS J.S.
EMBROIDERED ON IT.[END]

IT LOOKS LIKE
A PAIR OF
SUNGLASSES.[PAGE]
YOU THINK YOU'D
CUT A DASHING
FIGURE WEARING
THEM AT NIGHT![END]

IT'S A KEY WITH
THE WORD,
"OFFICE,"
INSCRIBED ON IT.[END]

YOU'RE IN A TOILETSTALL. THE STENCH
IS MORE THAN YOU
CAN HANDLE![END]

WHAT DO YOU THINK
YOU ARE DOING?[END]
YOU CAN'T DO THAT.[END]

YOU POP THE GUM
INTO YOUR MOUTH
AND BEGIN CHEWING.[PAGE]
AFTER A MOMENT IT
LOSES ITS FLAVOR.[END]
YOU CAN'T TAKE IT.[END]

THERE'S NOTHING
MORE HANDY THAN
A .38 AT YOUR
SIDE![END]

THE CABBY LOOKS
AT YOU AND SAYS,
"SORRY PAL, I
AIN'T GOT ANY
CHANGE!"[END]

"WAIT A MINUTE,"
YOU MUMBLE AS YOU
STOP YOURSELF.[PAGE]
"IF I LEAVE THIS
HERE, SOMEONE IS
SURE TO FIND IT!
AND THAT MIGHT BE
A BAD THING!"[END]

WHAM! YOUR HAND
IMPACTS WITH A
SHARP STAB OF PAINAND THEN GOES
NUMB![END]

WHO ARE YOU
SPEAKING TO?[END]

YOUR VISION SWIMS
AND YOU STUMBLE
AWKWARDLY![PAGE]
CATCHING YOURSELF,YOU RUB YOUR
THROBBING TEMPLES![PAGE]
THE PAIN BEHIND
YOUR EYES IS
GETTING WORSE! YOUWISH YOU KNEW WHATTO DO ABOUT YOUR
MEMORY LOSS![PAGE]
MAYBE THAT WOULD
HELP ALLEVIATE THETERRIBLE PAIN![END]

YOU'RE IN A DANK,
DINGY WASHROOM.[PAGE]
FROM THE LOOK AND
SMELL OF IT, YOU
FIGURE THE JANITORMUST BE ON STRIKE.[END]

IT'S A DOOR THAT
LEADS OUT OF THE
WASHROOM AND
MOST LIKELY INTO
TROUBLE.[END]

YOU SEE YOURSELF
IN THE MIRROR.[PAGE]
THE RAGGED FACE OFA STRANGER STARES
BACK. YOU STILL
CAN'T REMEMBER WHOYOU ARE![END]

AN ELECTRIC LIGHT
IS HANGING FROM
THE CEILING.[END]

IT APPEARS TO BE
A SINK. RUST
STAINS SHOW WHERE
THE WATER
CONSTANTLY DRIPS.[END]

YOU JUST BLEW AWAYTHE MIRROR. IT
SHATTERS SENDING
SMALL SHARDS EVERYWHICH WAY![END]

THIS WASHROOM
REALLY NEEDS
A GOOD CLEANING.
NO... MAKE THAT A
GOOD FUMIGATION![END]
THE DOOR LEADS OUTTO A HALLWAY.[END]

IT'S A MIRROR WITHA SIMPLE WOODEN
FRAME.[END]

YOU'RE IN A DINGY
HALLWAY.[END]

THERE'S A PUDDLE
ON THE FLOOR.[END]

IT'S A PLAIN
WOODEN DOOR.[END]

THIS DOOR HAS
SCUFFS AND
SCRATCHES ON IT.[PAGE]
IT MUST BE USED
A LOT.[END]

YOU STEP INTO THE
POLICE STATION.[PAGE]
THE COPS QUICKLY
SURROUND YOU WITH
THEIR HANDS ON
THEIR CLUBS AND
GUNS.[PAGE]
THEY SEEM VERY
EAGER TO HEAR
YOUR STORY.[END]

THERE IS NOTHING
UNUSUAL ABOUT THISHALLWAY.[END]

YOU'RE IN THE
WOMEN'S WASHROOM.[END]

A FAINT WHITE FILMCOVERS THE MIRROR.IT'S AS GRIMY AS
THE REST OF THIS
PLACE![END]
IT'S A LARGE METALWASTEBASKET.[END]

THIS LIGHT LOOKS
LIKE IT'S ON ITS
LAST LEG.[END]

YOU FIGURE IF YOU
WASHED YOUR HANDS
IN THIS SINK,
THEY'D JUST GET
DIRTIER.[END]

IT'S THE ENTRANCE
TO THE WOMEN'S
TOILET STALL.[END]

YOU'RE IN THE
LADIES ROOM.
SOMEHOW, YOU FEEL
OUT OF PLACE![END]

YOU'RE IN AN EMPTYSTALL.[PAGE]
YOU SEE A CRACK
IN THE TOILET AND
WATER LEAKING OUT
OF IT.[END]

IT'S A ROLL OF
TOILET PAPER.[PAGE]
IT LOOKS LIKE IT
HASN'T BEEN USED
YET.[END]

IT'S A PUDDLE OF
WATER THAT APPEARSTO BE COMING OUT
OF THE TOILET.[END]

THE PORCELAIN OF
THE TOILET SEEMS
TO HAVE BEEN
RECENTLY CRACKED.[PAGE]
WATER SLOWLY
TRICKLES FROM THE
BOWL AND FORMS A
PUDDLE OUT IN THE
HALLWAY.[END]

YOU ARE RELIEVED
THAT YOU FIND
NOTHING FLOATING
INSIDE.[END]

THE VAGUE
RECOLLECTION OF
YOUR MOTHER
TELLING YOU TO PUTTHE SEAT DOWN
COMES TO MIND.[END]

IT IS VERY QUIET
IN THE WOMEN'S
TOILET STALL. YOU
HEAR NOTHING
EXCEPT THE FAINT
TRICKLE OF WATER.[END]

YOUR STORY AND
THE THREE PIECES
OF EVIDENCE MADE
STERNWOOD AND
VICKERS LOOK
SUSPICIOUS.[PAGE]
BUT YOU CAN'T BE
CERTAIN OF THAT.[END]

YOU'RE IN WHAT
SEEMS TO BE A
DARK, EMPTY
RESTAURANT.[PAGE]
IT IS EITHER
CLOSED OR ELSE
YOU'VE SCARED
EVERYONE AWAY.[END]

THROUGH THE WINDOWYOU SEE AN EMPTY
STREET WITH NO
ONE IN SIGHT.[END]

IT'S A RICKETY
STAIRCASE WHICH
LEADS UP TO THE
SECOND FLOOR.[END]

THE DOOR HAS THE
WORD "CELLAR"
WRITTEN ON IT.[END]

IT'S THE FRONT
DOOR OF THE
RESTAURANT.[END]

IT'S A SHOT GLASS
FULL OF SELTZER.[END]

IT'S THE
COUNTERTOP.[PAGE]
YOU CATCH A SLIGHTREFLECTION OF
YOURSELF IN THE
HIGHLY POLISHED
FINISH.[END]

THIS ROOM IS
EMPTY.[END]

THE DOOR WON'T
OPEN.[PAGE]
IT MUST BE
LOCKED.[END]

YOU QUICKLY DOWN
THE SELTZER.[PAGE]
IT'S NOT YOUR
PREFERRED DRINK,
BUT IT'LL DO IN A
PINCH![END]

WITH A TELLTALE
CLICK, THE KEY
UNLOCKS THE FRONT
DOOR.[END]

WITH A BANG AND A
CRASH, YOU BLOW
AWAY THE WINDOW.[END]

YOU TRY TO OPEN
THE TRUNK BUT
IT'S LOCKED.[END]

THIS STAIRWAY
LEADS TO THE
SECOND FLOOR.[END]

YOU'RE IN THE
CELLAR.[PAGE]
THE PLACE LOOKS
LIKE IT COULD USE
A GOOD SWEEPING.[END]

IT'S THE KIND OF
LIGHT YOU'D EXPECTTO FIND IN A
CELLAR.[END]
A BARREL IS SET UPAGAINST THE WALL.[END]
IT'S A SPIGOT.[END]

YOU ARE MESMERIZEDBY THE INTRICATE
DESIGN OF THE
SPIDER WEB![END]

ROWS AND ROWS OF
DUSTY BOTTLES LINETHIS RACK.[PAGE]
ONE OF THE BOTTLESON THE RIGHT HAND
SIDE APPEARS TO BEUNUSUALLY CLEAN.[END]

YOU NOTICE A
LACK OF DUST.[PAGE]
HOW PECULIAR![END]

THE CONTENTS OF
THE BARREL GUSHES
OUT ONTO YOUR
SHOES.[END]

WHEN YOU HIT
THE BOTTLE, THE
WHOLE RACK SLIDES
TO THE SIDE.[PAGE]
A SECRET PASSAGE
IS REVEALED![END]

IT'S A DAMP AND
DREARY CELLAR.[END]
IT'S A BIG BARREL.[END]

IT'S A SMALL
CONNECTING ROOM
MADE OF STONE AND
BRICK.[END]

YOU SEE A SHAFT
WITH A LADDER
LEADING STRAIGHT
DOWN.[PAGE]
YOU ALMOST RETCH
AT THE NASTY SMELLRISING FROM THE
DEPTHS.[END]

IT'S A ROUND
WOODEN DOOR.[PAGE]
STRANGE DESIGN FORA DOOR![END]

WAIT A MINUTE!
COULD IT BE? YES,
IT IS! A LIGHT
BULB![END]

YOU GAG ON THE
STALE AIR. THIS
PLACE COULD USE
SOME CIRCULATION
IN HERE![END]
IT'S A DOOR.[END]

YOU'RE IN A SMALL
ROOM SET UP AS A
CASINO.[PAGE]
THE SILENCE IN
THIS PLACE IS
ALMOST DEAFENING![END]

THE COPS FIND
SOME INCRIMINATINGEVIDENCE AND
THEY SUSPECT
YOU COMMITTED JOEYSIEGEL'S MURDER
AND KIDNAPPED
MRS. STERNWOOD.[PAGE]
THE BAD BLOOD
BETWEEN YOU AND
SIEGEL WAS WELL
KNOWN.[PAGE]
IT DOESN'T TAKE
THEM LONG BEFORE
THEY BRING YOU
BEFORE THE JUDGE.[END]

BUT THERE IS TOO
LITTLE EVIDENCE
THAT STERNWOOD ANDVICKERS WERE
INVOLVED...[END]
ERROR[END]
ERROR[END]

YOU REMEMBER THE
LAST TIME YOU
PLAYED ROULETTE...20 BLACK- YOU
LOST![END]

IT'S A SLOT
MACHINE.[PAGE]
DO YOU FEEL LUCKY?[END]

WITH A PULL OF THELEVER, THE WHEELS
SPIN AND CLANG
AWAY![PAGE]
YOUR ANTICIPATION
HEIGHTENS, THE
EXCITEMENT BUILDS
AND THEN...[PAGE]
CLANK, CLANK,
CLANK- YOU LOSE.[END]

WELL AT LEAST YOURLUCK IS
CONSISTENT- ALL
BAD![END]

THE WHEELS BEGIN
TO SPIN AND THIS
TIME YOU CROSS
YOUR FINGERS
FOR LUCK.[PAGE]
CLANK, CLANK,
CLANK...RING![PAGE]
THE MUSIC OF
JANGLING QUARTERS
FILL YOUR EARS AS
YOUR WINNINGS FALLINTO THE TRAY![END]

THE CABBY
ACCELERATES IN A
SUDDEN BURST OF
SPEED![END]

THE CASINO IS
DESERTED.[END]

IT'S A ROULETTE
WHEEL.[END]

YOU ARE THROWN
AROUND BY THE
CABBY'S RECKLESS
DRIVING.[END]

IT WON'T OPEN.[PAGE]
YOU WONDER IF IT
CAN BE OPENED FROMTHIS SIDE.[END]

YOU STAND IN FRONTOF A SMALL
ELEVATOR.[END]
ERROR[END]

YOU'RE INSIDE
THE ELEVATOR.[PAGE]
WHICH FLOOR DO YOUWISH TO GO TO?[END]
THIS BUTTON IS FORTHE TOP FLOOR.[END]

THERE'S NOTHING
ON THE BUTTON.[END]

THIS IS THE BUTTONFOR THE FIRST
FLOOR.[END]

YOU'RE INSIDE THE
CRAMPED ELEVATOR.[END]

AS YOU PRESS THE
BUTTON, THE
ELEVATOR LURCHES
TO LIFE.[PAGE]
WITHIN MOMENTS,
IT STOPS AND THE
DOOR OPENS.[END]

THE DOOR CLOSES
AND THEN QUICKLY
OPENS AGAIN.[PAGE]
YOU PUSHED THE
BUTTON FOR THE
FLOOR THAT YOU
ARE ALREADY ON.[PAGE]
BOY, YOU SURE WENTNOWHERE FAST![END]

WHAT KIND OF ROOM
IS THIS?[PAGE]
YOU WONDER WHAT
WENT ON HERE?[END]

IT'S A BIZARRE
LOOKING CHAIR.[PAGE]
RESTRAINTS FOR THEARMS AND HEAD HAVEBEEN BUILT INTO
IT.[PAGE]
IT DOESN'T LOOK
TO BE THE MOST
COMFORTABLE OF
CHAIRS![END]

IT'S AN OLD
WASTEBASKET.[END]

IT'S AN EMPTY
MEDICINE VIAL.[PAGE]
"SODIUM PENTOTHAL"IS WRITTEN ON
THE LABEL.[PAGE]
YOU WONDER WHAT ITWAS USED FOR?[END]

THE MEDICINE
VIAL'S LABEL READS"MEDREZINE."[END]

IT'S AN EMPTY
MEDICINE VIAL OF
"DIETHANOL
TRIMENE."[PAGE]
THE NAME SOUNDS
FAMILIAR, BUT YOU
CAN'T REMEMBER
WHY.[END]

THERE'S A LITTLE
MEDICINE LEFT
IN THE CAPSULE.[PAGE]
THINKING OF THE
PAIN IN YOUR
ARM... YOU HAVE ANINKLING THAT IT
MIGHT SOMEHOW
INVOLVE YOU.[END]

IT'S AN ELEVATOR
BUTTON.[END]

IT'S AN UNUSED
MEDICINE CAPSULE.[PAGE]
YOU'VE SEEN
DOCTORS PLACE
MEDICINE IN THESE
FOR THEIR PATIENTSTO TAKE.[END]

YOU TAKE THE
CAPSULES, THINKINGTHEY MIGHT COME INHANDY LATER.[END]

YOU'RE INSIDE
A SMALL,
CLAUSTROPHOBIC
ROOM.[END]

NOTHING SEEMED TO
HAPPEN.[END]

THE CAPSULE
ALREADY CONTAINS
A DOSAGE OF
MEDICINE.[END]

MEDREZINE ONLY
COMES IN HANDY
WHEN ONE HAS
BEEN GIVEN A
LETHAL DOSE
OF NERVE GAS.[PAGE]
SINCE THAT IS NOT
YOUR CASE, THE
MEDICINE PROVES TOBE FATAL![PAGE]
YOUR VISION SWIMS
AND THEN BLACKNESSTAKES YOU AS YOU
QUICKLY LOSE
CONSCIOUSNESS![END]

THE CAPSULES ARE
EMPTY.[PAGE]
THERE'S NO
MEDICINE IN THEM.[END]

YOU'RE IN AN
OFFICE, THE STALE
AIR FILLED WITH
THE STENCH OF
DEATH.[PAGE]
LAZILY SLUMPED
OVER A DESK IS A
BODY RIDDLED WITH
BULLETS.[PAGE]
THE CORPSE GRIPS
A TELEPHONE IN ITSLEFT HAND.[END]

YOU'RE INSIDE
A EUROPEAN LUXURY
CAR.[END]

IT'S A PHONE
RECEIVER.[PAGE]
THE CORD HAS BEEN
PULLED OUT.[END]

A POOL OF BLOOD
LIES DRYING ON THEDESK TOP.[PAGE]
THE DRAWER ON THE
OTHER SIDE OF THE
DESK APPEARS AJAR.YOU NOTICE OLD
SCRATCHES AS IF ITWAS ONCE JIMMIED
OPEN.[END]

IT'S A WALL SAFE.
TOO BAD YOU NEVER
SHOWED MUCH
APTITUDE FOR SAFE
ROBBING.[END]

IT'S AN
OLD-FASHIONED
TELEPHONE.[PAGE]
THE CORD HANGS
LIMPLY FROM THE
USELESS THING.[END]

THROUGH THE WINDOWYOU NOTICE EASY
ACCESS TO THE FIREESCAPE.[END]

IT'S A COMMON #2
PENCIL.[END]

IT'S A KEY MARKED
"FRONT."[END]

IT'S AN UNLABELED
KEY.[END]

THE FADED YELLOW
OF THE MANILA
FOLDER CATCHES
YOUR EYE.[END]
IT'S A SMALL BOX.[END]

IT'S AN IOU.[PAGE]
SCRAWLED ACROSS ITIS: "ACE HARDING
OWES JOEY SIEGEL
$1,000."[END]

YOU FIDDLE WITH
THE DIAL,
LISTENING HARD FORTHE TELLTALE
SOUNDS OF TUMBLERSCLICKING INTO
PLACE...[PAGE]
AFTER A WHILE
NOTHING HAPPENS
AND YOU REALIZE
YOU WON'T BE
OPENING THIS SAFE
WITHOUT A
COMBINATION.[END]

CLICK!
THE TUMBLERS FALL
INTO PLACE. A
QUICK TUG OF THE
HANDLE AND THE
DOOR SWINGS OPEN![END]

AFTER TRYING THE
COMBINATION, YOU
TUG ON THE HANDLE.[PAGE]
YOU REALIZE YOU
HAVE THE WRONG
COMBINATION WHEN
THE DOOR FAILS TO
OPEN.[END]

CLICK!
WITH A TWIST, THE
KEY UNLOCKS THE
DOOR![END]

TYPICALLY, YOU'D
FIND FILES INSIDE.[END]

THERE'S A DEAD
BODY LYING JUST
INSIDE THE OFFICE.[END]

IT'S A RATHER NEW
WALL SAFE.[END]

IT'S A KEY TO
A FANCY FOREIGN
CAR.[END]

IT'S THE BODY
OF JOEY SIEGEL.[PAGE]
YOUR STOMACH DOES
A LURCH AS YOU
NOTICE THE BULLET
HOLES THAT RIDDLE
HIS BODY.[END]

YOU'RE IN THE
SECRETARY'S
OFFICE.[PAGE]
THE ODOR OF CHEAP
PERFUME LINGERS INTHE AIR.[END]

THROUGH THE WINDOWYOU SEE NOTHING
UNUSUAL.[END]

IT'S AN EVERYDAY,
RUN-OF-THE-MILL
DESK.[PAGE]
THE DRAWER APPEARSTO HAVE BEEN
RECENTLY PRIED
OPEN.[END]

IT'S A SMALL DESK
LAMP. FUNCTIONAL,
NOT DECORATIVE![END]

IT'S A TYPEWRITER.FOR THOSE WITH THEDEXTERITY, IT'S
PRETTY HANDY...[PAGE]
YOU, HOWEVER,
PREFER THE PENCIL![END]
IT'S A TELEPHONE.[END]

IT LOOKS LIKE
A LEGAL-SIZE
ENVELOPE.[END]

IT'S A BILL FROM
A PHARMACY. THE
ADDRESS READS:
DR. BRODY'S,
934 SHERMAN ST.
CHICAGO, IL.[PAGE]
"-INVOICE-
1. CAPSULES  $10
2. SODIUM
   PENTOTHAL $56
3. MEDREZINE $26
4. DIETHANOL
   TRIMENE   $40
TOTAL       $132"[END]

IT SOUNDS VAGUELY
FAMILIAR BUT YOU
CAN'T BE SURE.[END]

YOU'RE IN THE
CRAMPED QUARTERS
OF A SECRETARY'S
OFFICE.[END]
IT WON'T OPEN.[END]
IT WON'T CLOSE.[END]

YOU'RE IN A
DINGY UPSTAIRS
HALL.[PAGE]
YOU NOTICE SOME
FADED POSTERS
OF OLD BOXERS
COVERING THE
WALLS.[END]

IT'S A POSTER OF
SOME BOXER NAMED
"DOGHOUSE" RILEY.[END]

IT'S A POSTER OF ABOXER NAMED
"PUFF" MACMUFFEN.[END]

IT'S A POSTER OF
A BOXER, THE FACE
SEEMS SLIGHTLY
FAMILIAR.[PAGE]
THE NAME
UNDERNEATH READS
"ACE HARDING."[END]

YOU CAN'T SHAKE
THE FEELING THAT
YOU SHOULD KNOW
THIS GUY...[PAGE]
THE NAME IS
ACE HARDING...[PAGE]
ACE... IT SEEMS ASIF YOU CAN ALMOST
REMEMBER THEN THE
FEELING SLIPS AWAYAGAIN.[END]

THE MEMORIES FLOODBACK AS YOU
RECOGNIZE THE
POSTER OF YOU, ACEHARDING, TAKEN
DURING YOUR OLD
BOXING DAYS![PAGE]
YOUR RECALL THAT
YOUR MANAGER WAS AGUY NAMED JOEY
SIEGEL.[PAGE]
BUT THAT'S ABOUT
ALL YOU CAN
REMEMBER NICE
ABOUT THE GUY![END]

THE WALL SLIDES
BACK INTO PLACE,
SILENTLY HIDING
THE ELEVATOR.[END]

YOU'RE IN THE
SECOND FLOOR
HALLWAY.[END]

YOU'RE STANDING
ON THE THIRD FLOORFIRE ESCAPE.[PAGE]
A BOUT OF PANIC
HITS YOU AS YOU
STRUGGLE WITH
VERTIGO![END]

IT'S A WINDOW
LEADING INTO
THE BUILDING.[END]
THE FIRE ESCAPE ISPRETTY RUSTY.[END]

YOU'RE ON A FIRE
ESCAPE.[PAGE]
THE THEORY IS THATIF THERE'S A FIRE,YOU USE ONE OF
THESE TO ESCAPE.[END]

THE LADDER ENDS
SOME NINE FEET
ABOVE THE GROUND.[PAGE]
YOU COULD JUMP
DOWN TO THE ALLEY.[END]
IT'S A WINDOW.[END]

YOU'RE ON THE
STREET IN FRONT OFJOE'S PLACE.[PAGE]
A QUICK GLANCE
TELLS YOU NO ONE
ELSE IS AROUND.[END]

IT'S THE DOOR
LEADING INSIDE THEBUILDING.[END]

YOU'D JUST BE
WASTING YOUR
MONEY.[END]

IT'S A VERY
ELEGANT LUXURY
CAR.[END]

IT'S THE FRONT
DOOR TO THE
CAR.[END]

SUDDENLY, A PAIN
SHOOTS THROUGH
YOUR HEAD CAUSING
THE WORLD TO
MOMENTARILY
SPIN... [PAGE]
YOU DON'T KNOW
WHAT THAT WAS, BUTYOU KNOW IT CAN'T
BE GOOD![END]

A HOT FLASH PASSESTHROUGH YOU![PAGE]
SOMEHOW THE PAIN
SLOWLY EBBS.[PAGE]
YOU BEGIN TO FEEL
BETTER, ALMOST
LIKE TAKING A COOLDRINK OF WATER.[END]

IT'S A NARROW
ALLEY.[END]

YOU'RE STANDING ONTHE STREET IN
FRONT OF THE
RESTAURANT.[END]

CLICK!
THE DOOR IS NOW
UNLOCKED.[END]

YOU'RE IN THE
SEWERS UNDER THE
MANHOLE.[END]

THE MANHOLE COVER
SITS IN THE MIDDLEOF THE STREET.[END]

YOU'RE IN FRONT OFA NEWSSTAND.[PAGE]
YOU FEEL THAT THISMIGHT NOT BE
THE BEST TIME TO
BRUSH UP ON
CURRENT EVENTS.[END]

THE NEWSPAPERS AREFOR SALE.[PAGE]
YOU'D FEEL GUILTY
READING ONE
WITHOUT PAYING.[END]

THE HEADLINE
READS, "THE
JAPANESE BOMB
PEARL HARBOR!"[END]

THE NEWSBOY LOOKS
AT YOU AS THOUGH
HE RECOGNIZES YOU.[END]

THIS NEWSSTAND IS
MADE OF THE FINESTPLYWOOD.[END]

YOU'RE ON THE
STREET IN FRONT OFTHE NEWSSTAND.[END]

"IT'S TWENTY-FIVE
CENTS A COPY, MAC![PAGE]
IF YA WANT, TAKE
DA FAR RIGHT ONE,"SAYS THE NEWSBOY.[END]

YOU HAND THE
NEWSBOY A QUARTER
AND TAKE A PAPER.[END]

THE NEWSBOY SAYS,
"DA COPS HAVE
BEEN ROAMING
'ROUND HERE
LOOKING FOR
ANYONE SUSPICIOUS
LIKE.[PAGE]
'DEY GOT A CALL
FROM SOME DAME
WHO LIVES ACROSS
THE STREET FROM
JOE'S.[PAGE]
SHE SAID THAT SHE
SAW SOME FUNNY
GOINGS-ON 'ROUND
THERE, AND SHE
GAVE A DESCRIPTIONOF SOMEONE THAT
LOOKS AN AWFUL LOTLIKE YOU![PAGE]
YA BETTER WATCH
YOUR STEP, BUB!"[END]

THE NEWSBOY
SPLATTERS ALL OVERTHE FRONT PAGE,
PROBABLY THE ONLY
HEADLINE HE'LL
EVER MAKE.[PAGE]
UNFORTUNATELY,
IT'S PROBABLY
GOING TO BE THE
LAST HEADLINE THATYOU'LL EVER MAKE![END]

THE NEWSBOY SAYS
IN A LOW VOICE,
"ARE YA STILL
HERE?[PAGE]
YOU'D BETTER BEAT
IT, BUB!"[END]

THE CABBY LAUGHS
AND SAYS, "YA MUSTBE NEW IN TOWN ...WE'RE ALREADY
THERE!"[END]

YOU DON'T HAVE
ANY STRENGTH LEFT![END]

THE GUY GIVES YOU
A NASTY LOOK- YOU
DECIDE AGAINST
USING THE CAPSULE.[END]

YOU'RE STANDING ONTHE STREET IN
FRONT OF PETE'S
ALL NITE GUN
PALACE.[END]

THE WINDOW READS
"GUNS AND AMMO."[END]

IT'S THE ENTRANCE
TO THE STORE.[END]

IT LOOKS LIKE
A TRASH CAN.[END]

YOU'RE ON THE
STREET IN FRONT OFTHE GUN SHOP.[END]

YOU STAND AMONGST
THE RAMSHACKLE
BUILDINGS ON 
PEORIA ST.[END]

YOU'RE IN A DARK
ALLEY.[END]

THE CABBY
CHUCKLES, "HEY
MISTER, WHAT DO
YA MEAN? [PAGE]
